description: Models for a task and memory budget. provenOnly can return tested commands and a signed proof receipt when enabled. Use when the user states RAM or VRAM and needs model recommendations, not fine-tuning. Example: {"task":"chat","hardware":"8gb-laptop"}. Download is not run proof. provenOnly needs exact hardware and a run under 24 hours old. Read no-match reasons and retry guidance. Default answer is concise (at most 3200 bytes); use detail=full for the full record.

commercial.description: Request commercial-use information; license labels do not filter results.

detail.description: Concise by default; full returns the extended record and evidence.

hardware.description: Free text or preset for estimates. For provenOnly use an exact class: e2-8gb, e2-16gb, e2-32gb, c3-16gb, c3-32gb, apple-m2-16gb, rtx3060-12, rtx4060-8 or rtx4090-24. Generic memory never matches a measured class. No default.

model.description: Model name or owner/repo to check first; alternatives are labeled explicitly.

os.description: Client OS for the tested local server handoff when enabled.

provenOnly.description: Require fresh exact-hardware proof; returns testedRunPlan and receiptCard or no recommendation.

ramGb.description: System RAM in GB; use instead of hardware or gpu.

task.description: Task the model or service should perform.
